decisions.reason: Replacing INA219 with INA3221 among the loads on the standalone 3.3V rail does not change the OR-ing sources, method, or source-selection behavior.
The accepted current-monitor substitution does not change the addressable LEDs' 5V supply, switching, or level-shifting requirements.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing monitor_ic from INA219 to INA3221; no additional update or removal is required.
The INA3221 substitution concerns monitoring on the main-board rails and does not alter the switched 5V boost supply's control or powered loads.
Changing the downstream current-monitor IC does not alter the AXP2101 topology, battery power path, or VMID/VSYS requirements.
The current-monitor substitution does not change the battery connector, pinout, voltage range, placement, or AXP2101 connection.
The accepted INA3221 component does not entail any change to the main-board connector inventory or connector counts.
The current-monitor substitution does not affect panel controls, touch inputs, button placement, or their GPIO mappings.
Acceptance of INA3221 does not necessarily change the established I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The source decision does not specify any change to the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The INA3221 selection does not entail a change to any established ESP32 GPIO assignment.
Replacing the current-monitor IC does not change the board-chain order, interboard power rails, connectors, or forwarding behavior.
